about: Files jsDelivr refuses (over 20 MB: HTTP 403 'File size exceeded the configured limit of 20 MB.'), per repository@commit. Measured by S0 item 3 (2026-09-29) over the upstream trees of every listed game at its manifest's upstream.commit — so for those commits a repository NOT named here has no such file. loader/link.mjs cdnOverLimit reads it; any other commit is asked of jsDelivr's listing API.
